Extremely expensive for little food.
Mar 2025 • Solo
This must be the worst scam I've been involved in in Vietnam so far. Ordered pommes frites and chicken wings for dinner. First the journey came long before the chicken wings. So they were eaten up before the chicken came. Then came the surprise: 3 wings to the net sum of 99,000 dong. This must be a taste I thought, but this was what it cost. The total price was 163,000 dong. So the only thing they were lucky with was 7 up to 15,000 dong. So would recommend running by if you were to be this way. The staff was also most busy on the phone. I had to get up to get them to accept payment. The place will close soon with such poor service and prices?

Find a satisfactory restaurant when traveling to Da Nang'' Delicious, cheap, thoughtful and knows how to please guests who are different from local tastes''
Sep 2023 • Family
The family group went to Da Nang for a trip. The first day I went to Ba Na, I didn't come back until evening to eat and drink, then went to see the Dragon Bridge. The next day the family went to Linh Ung Pagoda in Son Tra, looked for a seafood restaurant to have dinner before returning to the hotel, looked around the review sites and found the best ones. Asking my classmates in Da Nang, they recommended Bien Rang restaurant, so I decided to go to Bien Rang. At first, I was a bit shy because the restaurant is located on Hoang Sa street, a tourist coastal road. The restaurant is very spacious and bright. Polite and not at all hustle and bustle like a local restaurant.
When you go to the restaurant and look at the menu, you also feel reassured because the price of each dish is very affordable. Order and observe. The restaurant is spacious, cool, polite space, clean. Young waiters take care of each table. Delicious and cheap food. Rated the location VIP 10, good service to please guests with different tastes. The group will return.

Seafood along MyKhe Beach
Dec 2019
Located along the stretch of MyKhe beach. Lots of selections here and price is affordable. The prices are clearly stated as how much per kilo. You will be charge according to the weight of the seafood you selected.
No double pricing for foreigner
The only obstacle here is it caters for mainly locals and the staffs do not understand English except for the senior staffs with very limited English.
First you get a table and you will be allocated table number ( you will be given a piece of paper with the table no written by the waiter)
Then go and select the seafood you want and the staff will weigh and tell you the weight of the selected seafood.. He will then ask you how you want it to be cook. 
The problem starts here as they do not speak English. They only know STEAM,BBQ,SPICY,and NO SPICY.
So we can only tell them its either to steam or BBQ, spicy or no spicy. Fried Rice is available here and like usual, when we ask what choice do we have - only seafood fried rice.
Wait at your table and the dish will come quite fast. Drinks can be order from your table. You can choose to sit either on the ground floor or second floor.
Seafood is very fresh here
